name: Sdwpf
context: SDWPF (Short-term Deterministic Wind Power Forecasting) dataset containing hourly meteorological observations and wind turbine power output. This dataset is widely used for wind power forecasting research, capturing the complex relationship between weather variables and actual power generation.

endo.name: active_power
endo.description: Actual active power output (Patv) of the wind turbine in kW. This is the primary target variable to be forecasted.

exo.name: temperature
exo.description: Temperature at 2 meters above ground (T2m) in Kelvin. Affects air density and turbine efficiency.

exo.name: surface_pressure
exo.description: Surface pressure (Sp) in Pa. Influences air density and power generation.

exo.name: relative_humidity
exo.description: Relative humidity (RelH) in percentage. Affects air density and turbine performance.

exo.name: wind_speed
exo.description: Wind speed (Wspd_w) at hub height. The most critical feature for wind power generation.

exo.name: wind_direction
exo.description: Wind direction (Wdir_w) in degrees. Influences wake effects and effective power capture.

exo.name: theoretical_power
exo.description: Theoretical power (Tp) calculated from wind speed. Serves as a strong baseline and important exogenous feature.
